name: ark4ne/openapi-writer
description: Framework-agnostic, fluent and immutable PHP builder for OpenAPI 3.0, 3.1 and 3.2 documents.

suggest.opis/json-schema: Required to validate documents against the official OpenAPI schemas (OpisJsonSchemaValidator).
suggest.symfony/yaml: Required to write documents as YAML (toYaml()).

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the whole PHPUnit test suite.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the tests with line coverage and fail under 95%.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan at max level on src/, tests/ and bin/, with the phpat architecture rules.
scripts-descriptions.mutation: Run mutation testing (requires infection to be installed globally).
scripts-descriptions.ci: Run every blocking check of the CI locally.
scripts-descriptions.benchmark: Build and write a document of 500 operations, and print the timings.
scripts-descriptions.progress: Rebuild the progress table of docs/README.md from the milestone checklists.
scripts-descriptions.fixtures:update: Rewrite the expected JSON files of tests/fixtures/ from the current output (review the diff).
